explanations.text:
●  the shape is named                                      ([the shape](rail))
  │     The rail tells a whole file, stage by stage,
  │     from the first thing the user does to the last
  │     thing the tool writes.
  │     For a markdown file the stages follow its sections.
  │
  ●  the rules bind the telling                            ([the rules](Rules))
  │     A head is an act with the one who acts in it,
  │     the pin on its right.
  │     Under it stand two to four full sentences, the
  │     purpose said in a sentence of its own.
  │     No programming words; short lines; a rule line
  │     before what is not the main run.
  │
  ●  one example shows it whole                        ([the example](Example))
        The hello world server, told as a rail.
        It exists so a writer copies a working shape
        instead of rereading the rules.
